paragraphs: Gemini Decisions API: Fast, calibrated multimodal decisions. Meet the Gemini Decisions API, powered by our state-of-the-art model Gemini Decision for fast, calibrated multimodal decisions.
Gemini Decisions API：快速、经过校准的多模态决策。隆重推出 Gemini Decisions API，它由我们最先进的模型 Gemini Decision 提供支持，旨在实现快速、经过校准的多模态决策。
